messages:
alex: Quick sync: drafting the external note after last night's service degradation. keeping it short. sharing a draft below and a couple of policy q's about RCA publication.

nina: drop heavy logs, keep customer-facing copy high-level. also confirm legal review for redactions. @sarah can you advise?

sarah: legal: OK to publish a redacted RCA for broad-impact incidents. do not include customer identifiers or internal IPs. we can share private, detailed RCAs to affected customers under existing confidentiality terms.

alex: draft for status page: "We experienced degraded availability between 22:10 and 22:38 UTC due to a configuration error affecting a subset of API customers. Service was restored and mitigations have been applied. A redacted postmortem will be posted as a follow-up." Thoughts?

tom: looks good. suggest adding who owns next steps and timing so customers know we have a plan. maybe: "Owner: platform; redacted postmortem targeted in 72 hours."

alex: proposed addition: 

"Mitigations applied: traffic rerouted, faulty routing rule reverted, and health checks tightened. Next steps: canary rollout across regions (owner: leon, ETA: 48h), pipeline validation checks (owner: tom, ETA: 10 business days)."

leon: I can run the canary. If nothing breaks it's 36h, otherwise 72h. I'll post updates to #incidents-status.

nina: also flag: this is the third routing-related event in the last 9 months. propose a small initiative to add end-to-end deployment gating and automated routing-rule audits. owner: platform lead (alex).

alex: agree. will create tickets and include that commitment in the external note as a high-level statement: "We are investigating systemic deployment processes to prevent recurrence." keep it non-technical.

sarah: on RCA sharing policy: for incidents impacting many customers, publish a redacted public RCA. for incidents with sensitive customer data or security implications, provide private RCAs to affected customers and keep internal forensic detail internal. I'll draft a short checklist for the comms team.

alex: ok adding: "A redacted RCA is targeted to be published within 72 hours; impacted customers will be contacted directly with additional details." anyone object?

tom: minor wording: say "targeted within 72 hours" not a hard SLA. also include link to status history.

alex: updated copy to: "A redacted RCA is targeted within 72 hours; we will post the link on the status page and contact impacted customers directly."

incident-bot: Action items created: PLAT-5012 (canary rollout, owner: leon), PLAT-5013 (pipeline checks, owner: tom), PLAT-5014 (deployment audit project, owner: alex). Due dates assigned per comments.

nina: can we add a follow-up verification in 30 days to confirm mitigations? owner: alex.

alex: added a 30-day verification to PLAT-5014 and will schedule calendar reminder.

leon: I'll kick off the canary now and post status updates.

alex: finalizing statuspage post and will send customer email draft to @sarah and @nina for review. planning to publish status update in 20 minutes. :thumbsup:
